description: A 64x64 source in four coloured quarters — red top-left, blue top-right, green bottom-left, white bottom-right — shown through a crop naming the top-right quarter alone. The reference is therefore a frame of solid blue: the crop takes a 32x32 rectangle and `fit` then scales that rectangle up to the whole 64x64 raster, which is the ordering this fixture exists to hold. An uncropped render of the same source is four quarters, so a build that ignored `crop` fails on every pixel outside the top-right; one that cropped from the wrong corner shows the wrong colour; and one that cropped *after* fitting — cropping the output rather than the source — shows a quarter of the picture with the rest transparent over black, rather than a full frame of one colour.
